Every note, reminder and waiting recording on this phone is deleted, since none of them can be opened, and the Notebook starts empty with a new key. Only a backup can bring them back. Completed tasks waiting for review are deleted too, and no backup holds them. Reminders that were already set may still ring. Recordings that arrived while the key was gone are kept. Automatic backups have to be set up again; the backups already in your folder stay there.

If Android can use the key again after a restart, everything in your Notebook would open again. Starting over anyway deletes the key and every note, reminder and waiting recording on this phone, and only a backup can bring them back.
